body:
## What it does

Watches for new episodes of a pair of technology shows and compresses each into a short briefing that separates what has substance from what is merely noisy. It puts the point in terms of your own situation and closes with a few moves worth making, so what lands is a decision aid rather than programme notes. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @Luca280 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
